1.Tips: Welcome to the latest Fight of Fates. First of all, let's get familiar with the battles.
Undertake the sacred duty of repairing Temporal Chaos and obtain an abundance of resources! In this place, every ending is a new beginning.
The Temporal Beacon can be used to enhance Hero Combat Ratings in the Temporal Rift.

2.Tips: Consume Continuum Essence and Continuum Cores to enhance Attack Ratings.

3.Tips: Continuum Essence and Continuum Cores may be acquired from the Fountain of Time, Temporal Feedback events and by completing certain Temporal Rift floors for the first time. Once a season has ended, all Continuum Essence and Continuum Cores will be destroyed.

1.Tips: Here, time does not dictate us, it is the culprit that spreads chaos.

2.Tips: Brave warriors tasked by the gods must descend deep into the chaotic whirlwinds of time and space. It falls to them to save Esperia from the encroaching chaos, defeat the monsters laying in wait, and restore order once again.

1.Tips: You're going to need the help of some heroes for this expedition. Tap "Defense Force", and place your Heroes.

2.Tips: Important! Heroes cannot be withdrawn during a Challenge. Defense Force heroes can be swapped out afterward by repeating the selected Challenge.

Gathering and conducting repairs will improve space-time stability, yielding even greater resources! The more resources you possess, the stronger you will become!
Your Defense Force seems to have casualties! If your losses become too great, tap this button.
